# Roman Mednitzer

> Senior Systems & Platform Engineer · Vienna, Austria

Canonical profile: https://rmednitzer.github.io/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-26.

## Profile

I have around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment.

## Personal projects

These are personal, AI-assisted projects outside employment. I use AI substantially for implementation, testing and documentation, and take responsibility for requirements, integration decisions, review and operational validation.

- [relay-shell](https://github.com/rmednitzer/relay-shell): Connects AI clients to shell commands, SSH and interactive sessions through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with operation records and configurable policy. It is open by default, runs with the service account’s authority and is not a sandbox.
- [osint-workbench](https://github.com/rmednitzer/osint-workbench): Brings public-information collection, evidence preservation and search into a self-hostable workbench, with optional enrichment and read-only assistant access. Work in progress, with bounded workflows and a disposable integration-test environment. Broader operational use still needs validation.

## Interests

I tend to follow a question across disciplines rather than stop where one field ends. AI, robotics and cybernetics interest me because they connect engineering with questions about intelligence, identity and how people might live. Human augmentation and space exploration appeal to the same curiosity: what could we become capable of, and what would it take to get there?

I like ambitious ideas and difficult problems, and I want room to question assumptions and change my mind. Open systems and digital sovereignty matter to me because I want to understand, adapt and retain control of the technology I use.

Hard science fiction gives me another way to explore those possibilities and their consequences. My musical tastes lean towards industrial, electronic body music (EBM) and dark ambient.
